'''0.24b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that adjusted the economy for killing opponents and purchasing rifle ammo.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* Fixed camera tilt to the left and strafe left in aiming mode
* Faster weapon change animation
* Increased the amount of money and reputation earned for killing opponents

===Equipment and armament===
* Reduced cost of ammunition 7.62x39 7N23 from 400 to 150
* Reduced cost of ammunition 5.45x39 7N10 from 500 to 200
* Reduced cost of ammunition 7.62x54 7N1 from 500 to 200

===User Interface===
* Increased duration of displaying battery charge on screen
* Fixed misalignment of a weapon’s sight and hit indicators in aiming mode

===Bug Fixes===
* Fixed bug occurring when running the game on Windows Vista
* Fixed some bugs that affect stability of the servers
